properties.Shadow Bind: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)
properties.Puncture: On a direct hit, all models hit suffer d3 damage points.
properties.Spontaneous Combustion: On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon's damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.
properties.Pyrocatalyst: This attack causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
properties.Vitriolic Trajectile: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
properties.Cumbersome: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.
properties.Aetheric Blast: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down. Cloud effects touched by the spray expire.
properties.Alchemical Accelerant: On a direct hit, a model hit by this attack suffers Oil for one round. (When a model affected by Oil suffers a fire damage roll, the roll is automatically boosted.)
properties.Psychoactive Gas: A living warbeast directly hit by this attack gains 1 fury point unless they can ignore gas effects.
properties.Psychomorphic Destabilizer: This attack causes magical damage. Models hit by this attack lose Incorporeal for one round.
properties.Steam Pressure: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, this weapon gains +4 RNG that activation.
properties.Chem Trail: On a direct hit, models hit by this weapon suffer the effects of the chosen Alchemical Vents effect. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Chem Trail.
properties.Reload [1]: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.
properties.Black Humor: This weapon gains Continuous Effect: Corrosion and Grievous Wounds for this attack. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)
properties.Experimental Warhead: Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire and Corrosion continuous effects.
properties.Critical Knockdown: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.
properties.Anesthesia: A living model damaged by an attack with this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
properties.Brain Damage: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.
properties.Quake: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.
properties.Rust: This attack causes no damage. Instead, on a direct hit constructs hit suffer –2 ARM for one turn.
properties.Smite (\u2605 Attack): The model hit is slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.
properties.Brutal Charge: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.
properties.Flame Burst: When this model boxes an enemy model with this weapon, enemy models within 1" of the boxed model suffer the Fire continuous effect.
properties.Exothermic Reaction: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, enemy models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and suffer the Fire continuous effect. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Then the boxed model is removed from play.
properties.Flare: On a direct hit, models lose Stealth and suffer –2 DEF for one turn.
properties.Mechanikal Seizure: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
properties.Momentum: A small- or medium-based model directly hit by this attack is slammed d3" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon. In addition to suffering a normal damage roll, large-based models hit by this attack become knocked down.
properties.Sleepwalker: This attack causes no damage. Instead, a living warrior model hit by this attack becomes stationary for one round. On a critical hit on a non-Leader living enemy warrior model, before it becomes stationary you take control of the model hit.
properties.Blood Boon: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending focus or fury points.
properties.Thunderbolt: Enemy models hit are pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.
properties.Grievous Wounds: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.
properties.Bewitch: After this attack has been resolved, take control of target living enemy non-Leader warrior model hit. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Bewitch expires.
properties.Inflict Pain: When it hits a warbeast with this weapon, this model can place 1 fury point on or remove 1 fury point from the warbeast.
properties.Drag: If this model hits an enemy model with an equal or smaller base with a basic attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved the hit model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.
properties.Knockdown: When a model is hit by an attack with this weapon, it becomes knocked down.
properties.Critical Paralysis: On a critical hit, a living model hit has its base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.
properties.Thresher (\u2605Attack): This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon's melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.
properties.Critical Grievous Wounds: On a critical hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.
properties.Electro Leap: When a model is directly hit with a basic attack made with this weapon, you can have lightning arc to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit.
properties.Combo Strike (\u2605 Attack): This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack.
properties.Volume Fire: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.
properties.Lone Gunman: When attacking with this weapon, this model cannot participate in combined ranged attacks.
properties.Flamethrower (AT): This weapon becomes Sp 8, POW 12, and gains Continuous Effect: Fire and Damage Type: Fire for this attack.
properties.Void Blast: This weapon becomes AOE 2, POW 14/8 for this attack. Models destroyed by this attack are removed from play.
properties.Full Auto (\u2605Attack): Instead of making one attack with this weapon, this model can make d3 attacks. Do not choose an attack type when resolving these attacks.
properties.Critical Decapitation: On a critical hit, double the damage exceeding the ARM of the model hit. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.
properties.Man Catcher: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model's melee range for one round.
properties.Free Fall: When a model with Flight is hit by this attack it becomes knocked down and loses Flight for one round.
properties.Polarize: If this attack directly hits an enemy model, before resolving damage immediately push models within 2" of the model hit 2" directly away or directly toward the model hit in the order you choose.
properties.Double Strike: This model can spend focus or fury points to make two additional attacks with this weapon for each focus or fury point spent.
properties.Stall: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
properties.Magnetic Hold: Enemy model/unit directly hit suffers –2 SPD and DEF and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks.
properties.Imperil: For one round, when a model/unit hit by this attack suffers a damage roll, add +2 to the roll.
properties.Ground Pounder (\u2605 Attack): Place a 3" template anywhere completely within this weapon's RNG in this model's LOS. This model makes one ranged attack roll against each model in the template. Ground Pounder attacks are simultaneous.
properties.Blasted Earth: Models hit suffer –2 SPD for one round.
properties.Targeting Flare: Instead of making an attack, place a 3" template within 10" — models in it lose Stealth.
properties.Direct Current: If this attack directly hits, all models in a line between the hit and this model suffer POW 10 electrical damage.
properties.Beacon: Friendly Faction models can charge an enemy hit by this weapon without spending focus, and gain +2 SPD.
properties.Ricochet: On a direct hit, make another attack against a model within 4" of the original, ignoring LOS/RNG.
properties.Sustained Attack: When attacking the last model hit by this weapon this activation, the attack automatically hits.
properties.Skewer: When this weapon damages a model with equal or smaller base, push it directly toward this model.
properties.Firing Formulae: Gain extra dice based on Permutation Servitor proximity.
properties.Detonation: After this attack is resolved remove this model from play.
properties.Dispel: Upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit hit immediately expire.
properties.Single Shot: After an attack with this weapon is resolved, this model cannot make another attack with it for one round.
properties.Earth Shaker: The model hit and models within 2" become knocked down.
properties.Dark Banishment: When this model hits an enemy model with this weapon during its activation, after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within d6+3" of its current location. A model can be placed by Dark Banishment only once per turn.
properties.Black Mark: When this model destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with an attack with this weapon, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token.
properties.Soul Chambered [1]: This model can spend 1 essence point or soul token to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.
properties.Admonisher: When an enemy model is directly hit by an attack with this weapon, the d3 nearest enemy models within 4" of the model hit suffer an unboostable POW 10 magical damage roll. These damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve damage resulting from Admonisher simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that directly hit.
properties.Coil: When this model directly hits a model with this weapon, this model's melee attacks against that model automatically hit for one turn.
properties.Chain Attack: Grab & Smash: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately make a head-butt or throw power attack against that model even if it charged that activation.
properties.Ghost Shot: This model ignores LOS, concealment, and cover when making attacks with this weapon.
properties.Devour Soul: When this model destroys a living enemy model with this weapon and generates a soul token, you can choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model's soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models cannot gain soul tokens from models destroyed by this weapon.
properties.Luck: When attacking with this weapon, this model can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Luck.
properties.Poison: Gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against living models.
properties.Sacral Blade: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending essence points.
properties.Chain Weapon: Attacks with this weapon ignore the Buckler and Shield weapon qualities and Shield Wall ARM bonus.
